title: Fire Academy
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Demonstrate compliance with state Fire Training Requirements for Firefighter I.
Demonstrate compliance with National Fire Protection Association Standards.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (FTECH318, FTECH319). They match closed-list FTECH 318 and FTECH 319.

Under 'REQUIRED PREPARATION' the catalog names FTECH 301 (formerly FSCI 301) and EMS 350 or EMS 390 with a grade of C or better. It also requires a physical agility test with a valid CPAT card and a physician's statement with a valid healthcare CPR card. These are entry prerequisites, not award requirements, so they are not placed in blocks.
An outer heading 'Fire Academy (Total 17) Complete all of the following' wraps the single required block. It is recorded as one block.

The outcomes lead-in sentence appears twice. The first time it is followed by the stray text 'Fire Academy, Cert *' and no outcomes. The outcomes are taken from under the 'Program Learning Outcomes' heading.
The source URL slug says 'summer-2020' although the stated catalog year is 2026-2027.
